dex.entry: The fourth and final kindling of the Gilpaw line, reached only by a Corolion raised far beyond most wayfarings — and the only known kin to kindle into the legendary register. art.silhouette: Towering luminous lion of living dawn-light, gold-white body with a soft sunrise gradient of rose and amber along the spine; the carved stone corona of its old form worn as a vast crown ring behind its head, now blazing; long light-trailing mane and tail like streamers of morning sky, calm sovereign eyes. Epic, serene, sunrise-bringing at 64px.

art.direction: Raise one line far enough and it answers the Long Dusk in person — a walking sunrise.
